notes: needs_ruling: «قال قرأت في أصل إسماعيل بن عياش» reads from the author's original book; the author of a cited book is a rule-11 case, so the group ending at إسماعيل بن عياش is a reading to rule on
«- قال ابن عوف -» is an editor's gloss: left out
«أن ثوبان، حدثهم أنهم» is a rule-5 link: Jubayr says Thawban told them, so Thawban is the last link before the Prophet's saying
«وحدثنا محمد بن إسماعيل» starts a second isnad with the same saying: a second group, same head محمد بن عوف

fixes.reason: K6I's sequence stops at شريح بن عبيد; the text continues through جبير بن نفير to ثوبان.
